academic_bew.name: Generic ballot (Bafumi, Erikson & Wlezien)
academic_bew.citation: Bafumi, Erikson & Wlezien, 'Balancing, Generic Polls and Midterm Congressional Elections', Journal of Politics 72(3), 2010
academic_bew.attribution: Our implementation of BEW's published midterm equations, run on our generic-ballot average.
notes: tide is BEW's vote equation; their separate seats equation is reported as a diagnostic and is not used downstream

academic_referendum.name: Referendum (approval + income, no exposure)
academic_referendum.citation: Tufte, 'Determinants of the Outcomes of Midterm Congressional Elections', APSR 69(3), 1975; the modern version is Lewis-Beck & Tien
academic_referendum.attribution: Our fit of the referendum specification. NOT Lewis-Beck & Tien's published forecast.

inputs.approval_source: hand-set (Gallup basis); no live approval feed yet
inputs.income_source: FRED income_growth_ytd as of 2026-08-22, 6 month(s) of the year in hand

benchmark.claim: Republicans lose about 28 House seats and the House
benchmark.authors: Charles Tien and Michael S. Lewis-Beck
benchmark.note: their DV is seat change, ours is vote share — the comparison is directional, not a reproduction

notes: no exposure term — this is the unconditioned referendum specification, and the gap against our fundamentals model IS the finding

academic_state_approval_economy.name: State approval + state economy (Enns et al.)
academic_state_approval_economy.citation: Enns, Lagodny, Colner & Kumar, 'Understanding Biden's Exit and the 2024 Election: The State Presidential Approval-State Economy Model', PS: Political Science & Politics, October 2024
academic_state_approval_economy.attribution: Not implemented. Listed so the gap is visible.
missing: state-level presidential approval estimates (MRP from national poll microdata)
state-level economic series (FRED has state personal income and unemployment; we capture neither, and the paper's choice of series is unread)
a specification for Senate races — the published DV is presidential vote by state
